entities.name: Parnesse
entities.description: A vampire wizard and portrait artist of the Maestros family in New Capenna.

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: Parnesse's wife and fiance, daughter of Anhelo.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: Errant's father and one of the first vampires.

entities.name: Fiero Vespin
entities.description: Maestros assassin and art dealer who attacked Parnesse.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who attacked New Capenna.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: Vampire crime family of New Capenna.

events.summary: Fiero Vespin attacks Parnesse before her rehearsal dinner, breaking her ribs; she refuses to tell Errant.
events.quote: Fiero attacked Parnesse before their rehearsal dinner, leaving Parnesse with broken ribs and smelling of blood.

events.summary: Parnesse and Errant join the resistance against the Phyrexians; Parnesse is injured and healed by Della.
events.quote: but was later healed by Della and survived the invasion.

relations.quote: Parnesse is the wife of Errant
